method: Percentile cluster bootstrap: resample 20 populations with replacement 20000 times; take 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles
raw_aggregation: Two candidates averaged per parent; three parents averaged per population
s3_aggregation: V-selected candidate gain or parent-retention zero per parent; three outputs averaged per population
default_H: 12 fixed opponents, 20 game repeats, 100 rounds; own payoff normalized per round before parent subtraction
invalid_or_failed_candidates: Included as zero gain via parent fallback
panel_c: Paired population trajectories and means; no confidence intervals plotted.
